paper_style.palette_strategy: 表格使用四种固定 dataset 浅色列带（RE10K 米色、DL3DV 蓝色、MVImgNet 绿色、CO3Dv2 紫色），粗体和 ↑/↓ 负责比较方向；Figure 1–3 另用红绿/角色色标示流程、轨迹或 context/target，均配直接文字。
paper_style.vector_raster_mix: 正文文字、箭头、规则和表格数值为矢量；Figure 1–3 的图像 tile/轨迹渲染为栅格并与矢量标签混排，整体为 mixed。
paper_style.style_consistency: Nimbus Roman/Computer Modern 字体和四 dataset 表头在 Tables 1–9 高度一致；Figure 1 的模块色与附录 Figure 2/3 的角色边条有共同红绿语义但不共用独立 legend。

figures.label: Figure 1

caption.text: Figure 1: XFactor combines a [P OSE E NC, R ENDER] stereo-monocular model with our proposed transferability objective to learn transferable camera pose latents. Given a pair of input images, we apply two augmentations that minimize pixel content overlap while preserving pose information, such as inverse masking. The stereo P OSE E NC extracts the relative pose latent from the first pair. Then, given the context image from the second pair and the first’s target pose, the renderer is asked to reconstruct the second’s target.

color.semantic_mapping: 青绿色 POSEENC、金色 RENDER、靛蓝/粉色增强分支、红绿角色条和黑色流程箭头；颜色与直接标签、空间位置冗余编码模块角色。

page-width 单图将方法接口与 loss 接到后续实验。

figures.label: Figure 2

caption.text: Figure 2: Qualitative Robustness Analysis of TPS Oracles. We evaluate the robustness of VGGT (Wang et al., 2025b) and COLMAP (Schönberger et al., 2016; Schönberger & Frahm, 2016b) oracles against visual corruptions. (a) VGGT is effectively invariant to minor distortions, while COLMAP quickly diverges. (b) VGGT maintains robustness even under significant random distortion, whereas COLMAP fails to register poses entirely.

figures.label: Figure 3

caption.text: Figure 3: Supervised Methods Also Struggle. Substantial reconstruction artifacts are also observed in supervised models when rendering difficult target views. The first and last frames are used as context views. (a) The supervised baseline, LVSM (Jin et al., 2024), excels at reconstructing easier target views. (b) However, LVSM struggles to cleanly render difficult target views, showing blurry or warped artifacts in the reconstruction.

tables.label: Table 1

caption.text: Table 1: The Transferability Test. We compare the transferability of XFactor’s, RayZer’s, and RUST’s pose representations across four datasets. We evaluate using TPS with RRA, RTA, and AUC at different error thresholds. For all metrics except FID, higher is better. Visualizations of transfer renderings and camera trajectories extracted with O RACLE are shown for each method above. The target trajectory is visualized in red, XFactor in green, RayZer in blue, and RUST in gold.

tables.uncertainty: 无 error bar、区间、重复或失败值；FID 与 accuracy 均为 point estimate。
tables.data_and_statistics: 每个 dataset 对 4000 对序列、每对 5 个等间隔 target frames 做 TPS/RRA/RTA/AUC，并计算输入与渲染目标序列 FID；数值按 dataset 平均。
tables.evidence_relation: Figure 1 的跨 pair transfer 接口 → Table 1 headline → §4.1 主结果；Table 2 probe 和 Table 3 ablation 提供 representation/设计对照。
design_strengths: 定性 rendering/trajectory 与数值 TPS/FID 同页。
阈值组和方法×dataset 多级表头适合快速比较。
caption 给出轨迹颜色及指标方向。
design_weaknesses: 4×4 定性小网格密集，缩放和灰度下轨迹易混。
FID 与角度 accuracy 量纲混排，缺少样本数和不确定性。
粗体只表明局部最优，不代表跨序列稳健性。
tables.reusable_pattern: 在主矩阵上方放同一评价对象的定性 rendering/trajectory，并将阈值嵌入 metric 首列。

tables.label: Table 8

caption.text: Table 8: Quantitative Robustness Analysis of TPS Oracles. We evaluate the robustness of the VGGT (Wang et al., 2025b) and COLMAP (Schönberger et al., 2016; Schönberger & Frahm, 2016b) oracles against visual corruptions by measuring the TPS between reference and corrupted videos. A weak distortion, visualized in Fig. 2 (a), is applied to the video. We find that the VGGT oracle is significantly more robust across all datasets and metrics. In contrast, the COLMAP oracle suffers from an excessive rejection ratio, diminishing the utility of the evaluation samples.

tables.evidence_relation: Figure 2(a) weak distortion 的定性轨迹 → Table 8 定量 robustness/rejection → Figure 2(b) heavy failure 与 Table 9 transferred-video validity。
design_strengths: 将 evaluator failure 转成 metric 和成功率的双层证据。
caption 明确 weak distortion 来自 Fig. 2(a) 并直述主发现。
design_weaknesses: 缺少 denominator、拒绝计数和不确定性。

cross_object_system.visual_narrative: Figure 1 exposes the pose-preserving transfer interface; Tables 1–3 establish transfer, probe, and structural ablations; Tables 4–7 bound reconstruction, objective, and corruption behavior; Figure 2/Table 8/Table 9 audit oracle validity; Figure 3 displays supervised reconstruction failure.
cross_object_system.caption_system: Captions use title plus setup/comparison; Figure 2, Figure 3, Table 8, and Table 9 state main findings, while Tables 1–7 mostly leave the numerical conclusion to the body. Table 4 is the shortest and least self-contained caption.
cross_object_system.table_header_system: Tables 1–9 use model/method as the top group and RE10K, DL3DV, MVImgNet, CO3Dv2 as the second group; metric and angle threshold are combined in the first column and ↑/↓ are printed beside metrics.
cross_object_system.method_result_ablation_link: POSEENC/RENDER and transferability from Figure 1 are tested in Table 1, separated by pose probe in Table 2, and perturbed by bottleneck, explicit pose, extra views, objective replacement, and temporal shifts in Tables 3, 6, and 7.
cross_object_system.main_appendix_link: Main Tables 1–3 carry transfer/probe/ablation claims; Appendix Tables 4–7 add interpolation and objective controls, while Figure 2/Table 8/Table 9 qualify the TPS oracle and Figure 3 qualifies supervised reconstruction.
cross_object_system.typography_consistency: Nimbus Roman No9 L and Computer Modern math are stable across captions, body cells, headers, and equations; table cells are approximately 6 pt and captions approximately 10 pt, with bold/medium headers.
cross_object_system.color_consistency: Dataset pastel columns persist across all tables; role colors in Figure 1 and red/green trajectory or edge bars in Figures 2–3 are direct-label redundant encodings, but there is no shared formal legend and grayscale separation is weaker.

most_reusable_patterns: Stable method × dataset multi-level headers with metric direction printed in the first column.
Quantitative transfer matrix paired with same-page qualitative renderings and trajectories.
Evaluator robustness reported with both task metrics and Success Rate so rejection is visible.
A fixed metric skeleton reused for headline, probe, ablation, and corruption comparisons.
highest_value_objects: Figure 1: compactly exposes the cross-pair pose-to-render interface.
Table 1: aligns qualitative transfer trajectories with TPS/FID headline metrics.
Table 3: turns transferability-versus-probe differences into structural counterfactuals.
Figure 2 plus Table 8: closes the qualitative–quantitative TPS-oracle robustness loop.
failure_patterns: Captions and headers omit denominator, repetition, uncertainty, or units for many point estimates.
Small type, dataset pastel bands, and dense qualitative grids degrade ordinary-scale and grayscale readability.
COLMAP rejection can make transferability unmeasurable; it must not be silently interpreted as model quality.
Figure 3 shows artifact types without frame indices, thresholds, or a quantitative matched control.
final_judgment.one_sentence_visual_strategy: The paper uses a stable dataset-grouped table system to separate transferability from latent pose information, then layers qualitative trajectories, design ablations, and oracle/supervised failure evidence to bound the true-NVS claim.
